reading.title: New NASA Seed Funding Primes Small Businesses for Innovation
reading.summary: Awards to small businesses around the country are addressing some of NASA’s most crucial technology needs for exploration of the Moon and Mars while fueling the U.S. space economy. NASA’s Small Business Innovation Research/Small Business Technology Transfer (SBIR/STTR) program recently selected 302 innovative projects, for a total investment of up to $171 million in seed […]

news.title: Trump touts meeting with Xi and Putin but offers few results
news.summary: At a White House press conference Friday, Trump offered little in actual results of the meetings, beyond a joint statement on unity over some issues.
